1  PRAYER:

Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In  issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents herein to pass an A  pay additional compensation, solatium and interest amount in respect of  acquisition of petitioner's landed properties comprised in Survey Numbe  of an extent of 0.36.1 Hectares, 43/1D1 of an extent of 0.30.5 Hectares  43/1D2 of an extent of 0.40.5 Hectares, situated at Mayanoor Village,
 Krishnarayapuram Taluk, Karur District and to pay compensation for loss  coconut trees in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and  Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2  based on the notification issued by the first respondent herein in  Rc.No.C2/17641/2008, dated 11.01.2023.
 For Petitioner : Mr.C.Gangai Am  For R1 to R4 : Mr.P.Subbaraj
Special
Govern  ORDER
The petitioner is the absolute owner of the properties in question.
Acquisition proceedings were initiated in the year 2018.
The notification was published on 11.01.2023 under Section 11(1) of the Act of 2013.
The petitioner relies upon multiple communications with regard to the issuance of an Award and payment of compensation.
In spite of lapse of considerable period of time, it is stated that the award has not been issued and compensation has not been paid.
_ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
The learned Special Government Pleader accepts notice on behalf of the respondents 1 to 4.
He submits that the matter is pending before the Principal Secretary, Finance Department and that about six months is required to complete the process.
3. The position that emerges on examining the affidavit and documents is that the petitioner is not in a position to use his land in view of the acquisition proceedings.
He has also not received any compensation till date.
In these circumstances, it is just and necessary that action be taken on an expeditious basis to issue an award and pay compensation.

4. Accordingly, the respondents 3 and 4 are directed to issue the award and disburse the compensation to the petitioner for the acquisition of his lands within three (3) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. This Writ Petition is disposed of on these terms.
No costs.
